releaseNotes:
- Lunaverse Agent now runs on the Pi runtime with native questions, activity, subagents, permissions, Skills, background work, and clear error recovery
- Existing installations move from the legacy App gateway to IDE Cloud automatically, while restart-safe sessions refresh or return to a clear sign-in state
- Login, registration, account, usage, Agent tools, and publishing now share one IDE Cloud gateway and identify 1.3.8 traffic for migration observability
- Release Center and Lunaverse Agent now share one Cloud workflow truth for readiness, generation-fenced activation, reconciliation, immutable manifest identity, and actual runtime visibility
releaseNotesZh:
- Lunaverse Agent 现已切换到 Pi 运行时，完整支持原生提问、活动状态、子 Agent、权限、Skills、后台任务与清晰的错误恢复
- 旧安装会自动从 App 旧网关迁移到 IDE Cloud，登录会话可在重启后安全刷新，失效时也会明确返回重新登录状态
- 登录、注册、账号、用量、Agent 工具与发布现统一使用同一 IDE Cloud 网关，并可识别 1.3.8 流量以观测迁移进度
- Release Center 与 Lunaverse Agent 现共享同一份 Cloud 发布工作流真相，统一展示就绪检查、generation 防串版激活、对账、不可变 manifest 身份与真实运行时可见性
